description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Chart' responsible for writing chart data into the XLSX (Excel) XML format, specifically for charts within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It contains methods for generating various parts of the chart's XML representation, including plot areas, axes, titles, legends, series, and visual styles.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: A class responsible for generating the XML representation of charts within a PHPSpreadsheet XLSX writer. It handles creating the chart space, plot area, axes, legends, titles, and styles, facilitating the export of chart objects into the Excel Open XML format.
